conventions.convention: Full AC is assumed throughout the fixed-point results and examples; the finite matrix and character calculations introduce no additional choice assumption.
The framed connection definition starts with N≥2. The independently stated stable matrix quotient and its fixed-point lemma allow N≥1, including the rank-one example.

The positive parameter ζ labels the stability chamber of the complex quotient; it is not another complex equation. Stability means that all B₁,B₂ words applied to I(W) span V. Ordinary ASD comparisons use the separate zero-FI regular, meaning stable-and-costable, dictionary.

The torus acts by (t₁B₁,t₂B₂,Ih⁻¹,t₁t₂hJ). The eα are dual framing characters: W has character Σeα⁻¹, while the lifted word-generated V has weights eαt₁ⁱt₂ʲ. Additive weights are εᵢ=c₁(tᵢ) and aα=c₁(eα).

Young diagrams are finite downward-closed subsets of the nonnegative integer quadrant, with the origin box indexed (0,0). The empty tuple at k=0 has Euler product 1 and contributes constant coefficient 1.

The stereographic orientation is dx¹∧dx²∧dx³∧dx⁴>0; B_N(X,Y)=−tr_N(XY), ASD means F⁺=0, and its nonnegative instanton label is k=−q_N. The definition does not infer U(N) integrality from the supplier's SU(2) clause.

Euler denominators use complex tangent weights with multiplicity over the rational function field in algebraically independent equivariant variables. The series is coefficientwise formal. Compact ABBV supplies no noncompact pushforward; the separately constructed localized Borel–Moore trace supplies that identity.

load_bearing.statement: Assume full AC, N≥1, k≥0 and ζ>0, with the stated stable complex ADHM quotient and rotation/dual-framing action. The quotient is smooth of complex dimension 2kN; its isolated fixed points correspond to N-tuples of partitions of total size k. Writing V_Y=Σα eα Σ(i,j)∈Yα t₁ⁱt₂ʲ and W=Σα eα⁻¹, its tangent character is V_Y∨V_Y(t₁+t₂−1−t₁t₂)+V_Y∨W∨+t₁t₂WV_Y. Its tangent weights are nonzero and define a finite coefficientwise formal reciprocal-Euler series. The quotient is separated, smooth and finite type, with a finite invariant affine word-slice atlas.

Under full AC, N≥1, k≥0, ζ>0 and the stated stable ADHM and torus conventions, the partition fixed points and tangent characters give Z_N^fp(q)=Σk≥0 q^k Σ|Y|=k E_Y⁻¹ as a formal series. A supplied equivariant Gieseker isomorphism transfers the fixed-point and tangent assertions. The ordinary ASD comparison uses only the separate conditional zero-FI regular dictionary, including its rank-one boundary result. A separately proved noncompact pushforward with the stated localization identity evaluates the unit to the displayed coefficient. Compact ABBV alone does not supply this identity, and no continuum path-integral identification is asserted.

For N≥2, defines framed smooth unitary ASD connections on the oriented round S⁴, charge k=−q_N, ADHM maps and both moment-map expressions, word stability, the stable complex quotient and real level quotients, framed torsion-free sheaf moduli, Uhlenbeck strata, and the rotation/dual-framing torus action. It asserts no real/complex quotient or instanton correspondence.

alerts.finding: The Statement says, “For the adopted round S^4_r N=2* model, specialize to N=2, ε₁=ε₂=r⁻¹,” and Proof 5.1 asserts this specialization for the entire formal series. The cited batch-12 lemma works over algebraically independent rotation weights and does not prove coefficientwise regularity along ε₁=ε₂. Already for Y₁={(0,0),(1,0)}, Y₂=∅, its tangent character contains the self-color weights ε₁, 2ε₁, ε₂, ε₂−ε₁. The last denominator vanishes on the proposed diagonal, while the mass-shifted numerator is generically nonzero. Cancellation after summing all partitions may make the coefficient regular, but that all-charge regularity or an explicit limiting prescription is not established in this proof or the cited ADHM result. This flags an unsupported specialization, not a claim that the summed coefficient actually has a pole.
